HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Utsav from other faiths? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Utsav from other faiths has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Utsav from other faiths to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsav from other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number.
   D. Say Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

4. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga.
   D. Say Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Buddhist Vihaar in Africa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Vihaar in Africa.
   D. Say Buddhist Vihaar in Africa has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Communal aspects of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Communal aspects of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communal aspects of Yoga.
   C. Apply the teaching of Communal aspects of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Communal aspects of Yoga has no place in daily life.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

8. Which response best shows understanding of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues .
   C. Say Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptures and Moral values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Scriptures and Moral values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptures and Moral values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Scriptures and Moral values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptures and Moral values.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7..
   B. Use Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptures and Moral values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Vihaar in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Communal aspects of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. D — Apply the teaching of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Scriptures and Moral values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Scriptures and Moral values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
